datasets.name: MERRA-2
datasets.sampling: Every 8th latitude and longitude cell; no interpolation. Statistics use all valid cells (unweighted). Regional values are single nearest grid cells, not regional averages.

drydays.description: count of days with precipitation < 1 mm

label.pt: Duração da maior onda de calor

HWD.description: Heatwave Duration (length of the longest number of consecutive days satisfying the heatwave criteria of at least three consecutive days above the 90th percentile)

datasets.name: AIRS / Aqua
datasets.sampling: All valid TSurfAir footprints with TSurfAir_QC equal to 0 or 1; kelvin converted to degrees Celsius. One granule, no spatial interpolation.

datasets.name: Sentinel-5P / TROPOMI
datasets.sampling: Every 12th scanline and ground pixel with qa_value >= 0.5. Statistics use all valid footprints. 1 DU = 4.4615e-4 mol/m².
